question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of post-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass in relation to recycled materials?
data_point: mass fraction of post-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass
description: The mass fraction of post-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass refers to the proportion of materials in a product that come from recycled sources, specifically materials that have been used and discarded by consumers. This metric helps in assessing the extent to which recycled materials are incorporated into new products, contributing to the circular economy by reducing the need for virgin materials and minimizing waste.
